description:
Zero-dependency lookup of BIC and bank name master data (BLZ/Bankleitzahl/BC/kod
        banky/bank code directories) for a given IBAN or country-specific bank code. Ships a small
        bundled offline fallback dataset per country ("Urladung") and can refresh its data lazily
        and asynchronously from the respective national registry at runtime, persisting the result
        to a local cache directory. Initial country coverage: Germany (DE), Austria (AT),
        Switzerland (CH), Czech Republic (CZ), Belgium (BE), Poland (PL).
